info.title: AgriMine API
info.description: Crop recommendation, soil health and Plan B for AgriMine. All logic lives in core/; this layer only validates and shapes.

get.summary: Counts, crops, the feature registry and languages

post.summary: Create a soil check: validate, predict and save in one transaction
Stateless recommendation for a set of readings (nothing is saved)
Crop Doctor: every reading against the crop's usual range
Plan B: how well the preferred crop fits and which crops fit better

get.summary: K-Means groups of similar conditions (rainfall x temperature)
Average temperature, rainfall and humidity of every crop

schema.title: Response Needs Api Insights Needs Get

get.summary: ID3 information gain of every reading at the tree's root, largest first

schema.title: Response Gain Api Insights Gain Get

get.summary: Apriori rules that end in a crop, strongest lift first
Held-out accuracy of the two classifiers

post.summary: ID3 decision tree: the prediction, the path it took, accuracy, alternatives
Model Council: Naive Bayes against ID3 on the same readings, with the formula worked out
Cluster Explorer: K-Means groups on a PCA map, profiles, crops per group, choosing k

get.summary: Pattern Mining: Apriori association rules at the chosen support, confidence and size

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed of the stratified train / test split (the same for both models)

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: What the accuracy number means (English text, for teachers)

itemsets.title: Itemsets
itemsets.description: Frequent itemsets found at this minimum support and size

rules_total.title: Rules Total
rules_total.description: Rules that meet the settings (after the crop filter)

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Measured mining time of the first run for this support and size

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: The strongest rules by lift, then confidence, then support (at most `limit`)

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: low / medium / high per reading (pH: acidic / neutral / alkaline)

status.title: Status
status.description: pending only for rows saved by the old Soil Analysis page

x.title: X
x.description: Four x values of one upside-down U (left leaf column, left, right, right)

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Cluster number (0-based) of a merge below the cut; null above the cut

diameter.title: Diameter
diameter.description: Widest distance inside the group that is split

size.title: Size
size.description: Crops in the group that is split

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: General guidance in English; not a fertiliser prescription

tip_key.title: Tip Key
tip_key.description: Stable key of the tip, e.g. 'P.high': clients translate it themselves

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The ONE error shape of the API.

points.title: Points
points.description: One [rainfall mm, temperature °C, cluster] triple per record, rounded to 0.1; a compact form on purpose (2,200 records)

default.title: Default
default.description: Median of the dataset: where a reading starts when no check is saved yet

cophenetic.title: Cophenetic
cophenetic.description: How faithfully the tree keeps the original distances (1 = perfectly)

crops.title: Crops
crops.description: The 22 crops; `order` indexes into this list

order.title: Order
order.description: Left-to-right order of the crops along the bottom of the dendrogram

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Height of the cut that gives k clusters

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.description: The k clusters from the agglomerative tree

diana_clusters.title: Diana Clusters
diana_clusters.description: The k clusters from top-down DIANA

same.title: Same
same.description: Whether both methods give the same clusters at this k

match.title: Match
match.description: Profile match 0-100 (similarity to the crop's average, NOT the ID3 tree)

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Depth the trained tree actually reached

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: Equal-frequency bin edges per feature key

purity.title: Purity
purity.description: Share of training rows at the final tree node that are this crop

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: K-Means group (0-based) the readings fall in

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: Held-out accuracy (stratified 80/20 split, same seed as everywhere else)

hardest.title: Hardest
hardest.description: Crops the tree finds hardest, by held-out accuracy (lowest first)

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: Feature key the tree asked about

level.title: Level
level.description: The bin the value fell into (very low ... very high)

range.title: Range
range.description: Numeric range of that bin, as English text

lo.title: Lo
lo.description: The bin starts here (value >= lo); null = no lower limit

hi.title: Hi
hi.description: The bin ends here (value < hi); null = no upper limit

gain.title: Gain
gain.description: Information gain of this split, in bits

rows_here.title: Rows Here
rows_here.description: Training rows that reached this node

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of the group's records that are the top crop

averages.title: Averages
averages.description: The group's centroid in real units, per feature key

inertia.title: Inertia
inertia.description: Sum of squared distances to the centroids (lower = tighter groups)

variance.title: Variance
variance.description: Share of the information that PC1 and PC2 keep

your_point.title: Your Point
your_point.description: The readings on the PCA map (PC1, PC2)

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Inertia and silhouette for k = 2 to 10

best_k.title: Best K
best_k.description: The k with the highest silhouette

available.title: Available
available.description: True when something answers on the lab's port (we started it, or `make lab` did)

url.title: Url
url.description: Where the browser should open the lab

note.title: Note
note.description: Why it is or is not running, for the person starting the app

top.title: Top
top.description: The six most likely crops by Naive Bayes

why.title: Why
why.description: Why Naive Bayes preferred its crop over the runner-up, one row per feature plus the prior

why_total.title: Why Total
why_total.description: Sum of 'why' = ln(odds of the winner over the runner-up)

per_crop.title: Per Crop
per_crop.description: Held-out accuracy of both models for every crop, ID3's weakest first

purity.title: Purity
purity.description: Share of training rows at the ID3 leaf that are the predicted crop

nb_probability.title: Nb Probability
nb_probability.description: The probability Naive Bayes gives ID3's crop

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Posterior probability of the winning crop

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: A feature key, or 'prior' (how common the crop is)

difference.title: Difference
difference.description: log P(x | winner) - log P(x | runner-up); positive favours the winner

mean.title: Mean
mean.description: The winning crop's mean for this feature

total.title: Total
total.description: How many rules ending in a crop exist at the default thresholds

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Gaussian Naive Bayes class probability (uncalibrated, not a yield forecast)

match.title: Match
match.description: Profile similarity 0-100: closeness to the crop's average, in units of its own spread

N.title: N
N.description: Nitrogen (N) (no unit stated by the dataset)

P.title: P
P.description: Phosphorus (P) (no unit stated by the dataset)

K.title: K
K.description: Potassium (K) (no unit stated by the dataset)

ph.title: Ph
ph.description: pH (no unit stated by the dataset)

Readings.title: Readings
Readings.description: The seven soil and weather readings. Ranges come from core/features.py.

id3_purity.title: Id3 Purity
id3_purity.description: Share of training rows at the ID3 leaf that are the predicted crop

similar.title: Similar
similar.description: Every crop except the best, ordered by match (used for Plan B)

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Feature keys closest to the best crop's usual conditions
